context: Season management in Convoca stores only explicit rows in the seasons table; there is no virtual/current-season fallback in the admin SeasonManager. Rankings default to the active season only if a seasons row with status='active' exists; otherwise rankings aggregate all finished events. The SeasonManager form uses HTML date inputs (YYYY-MM-DD), so season create/update validation must accept date-only strings and normalize them to start/end-of-day timestamps before persisting/filtering.
